original_test_intent: Change one approved BMC channel-access policy and prove the exact least-privilege state, effective access and complete restoration.
original_method: Do not invent fields; require channel/firmware schema, complete baseline, security approval, independent recovery, full readback and rollback.
manual_activity: Vendor/security owner defines every access field and approves one isolated channel; operator validates independent admin recovery before any future write.
safety_requirements: Never enable anonymous/admin access by guesswork

blocked_analysis.analysis: Channel, field meanings and least-privilege target define the operation and cannot be guessed as mere runtime parameters.

review_improvement: Prevents undefined access-control writes, privilege exposure and lockout while retaining the required functional change/readback/restore.
